concept: solo piano rehearsal in a recital room
ownership: agent-authored test targets do not become requester requirements

gates.criterion: Visible face/hair are recognizably guided by reference: short dark chin-length bob with airy fringe and comparable soft oval face; no identity or age assertion.
A musician actively performing at a recognizable piano in a music-rehearsal/small-recital context, not only an attractive portrait near a prop.
One main person, one piano, two hands; each hand continuously traces through wrist and forearm to that person, with no competing owner or extra limb.
Left fingertips visibly meet actual lower-register piano-key surfaces with key structure readable, not an adjacent rim/support or floating contact.
Right fingertips visibly meet actual higher-register piano-key surfaces with key structure readable; hand and contact separately visible from left.
Seated pelvis visibly supported by bench; bench and torso/leg chain remain physically coherent.
Both lower legs and shoes trace to person; left shoe meets floor and right shoe contacts rightmost sustain pedal, with full pedal assembly and floor simultaneously visible.
Face, both hand-key contacts and consequential seated/pedal support are assessable together in saved frame; a partial or off-frame endpoint cannot pass full relation.

strict_overall_rule: All gates pass and visible; partial/unobservable never counts as strict whole-scene pass. Audio timing, musical correctness of chord voicing, future audience, identity and age cannot be established from still image.
